description: This file defines the SnowBallClient class for interacting with the Amazon Import/Export Snowball service using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations indicating various operations available for managing Snowball resources.

classes.name: SnowBallClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Import/Export Snowball service, providing methods for managing Snowball jobs, addresses, clusters, and related operations.
